# PubMatic
> AI-powered ad tech platform for measurable advertising performance across buyers, publishers, commerce media, CTV, and mobile.

PubMatic provides programmatic advertising technology for publishers, media buyers, app developers, and commerce media operators, with products spanning supply-side monetization, audience and identity, curation, measurement, and omnichannel activation.

## Platform Overview
- [Home](https://pubmatic.com/): Overview of PubMatic’s AI-powered advertising technology platform and core solutions.
- [Publishers](https://pubmatic.com/publishers/): Publisher-focused monetization solutions across display, video, CTV, mobile app, and commerce media.
- [Buyers](https://pubmatic.com/buyers/): Media buyer solutions for supply path optimization, curation, addressability, and omnichannel activation.
- [Commerce Media](https://pubmatic.com/commerce-media/): Retail and commerce media platform capabilities for monetization, audience activation, and measurement.
- [CTV](https://pubmatic.com/ctv/): Connected TV advertising solutions for premium inventory monetization and programmatic buying.
- [Mobile App](https://pubmatic.com/mobile-app/): In-app monetization and demand solutions for mobile publishers and app developers.

## Publisher Solutions
- [OpenWrap](https://pubmatic.com/products/openwrap/): Header bidding and unified auction solution for web, app, and CTV publishers.
- [OpenWrap SDK](https://pubmatic.com/products/openwrap-sdk/): Mobile in-app bidding SDK for app monetization and auction management.
- [Activate](https://pubmatic.com/products/activate/): Workflow and campaign activation tools for publishers and media owners.
- [Connect](https://pubmatic.com/products/connect/): Supply-side platform capabilities for inventory monetization and demand access.
- [Monetization](https://pubmatic.com/publishers/): Overview of publisher monetization products and revenue optimization capabilities.
- [Addressability for Publishers](https://pubmatic.com/addressability/): Identity and addressability solutions supporting privacy-conscious monetization.

## Buyer Solutions
- [Buyers Overview](https://pubmatic.com/buyers/): Overview of buyer tools for premium supply access and performance optimization.
- [Activate for Buyers](https://pubmatic.com/products/activate/): Media activation and workflow tools for curated and direct programmatic buying.
- [Curated Demand](https://pubmatic.com/curated-demand/): Curation capabilities for packaging inventory, data, and deal-based activation.
- [Supply Path Optimization](https://pubmatic.com/buyers/): Buyer-focused efficiency and transparency across premium omnichannel supply.
- [Addressability](https://pubmatic.com/addressability/): Identity, audience, and privacy-safe targeting solutions for buyers and publishers.
- [CTV for Buyers](https://pubmatic.com/ctv/): Programmatic CTV buying capabilities with premium inventory and measurable outcomes.

## Commerce Media
- [Commerce Media Overview](https://pubmatic.com/commerce-media/): End-to-end commerce media platform for retailers, marketplaces, and advertisers.
- [Retail Media](https://pubmatic.com/commerce-media/): Retail media monetization and audience activation across owned and offsite channels.
- [Audience Activation](https://pubmatic.com/commerce-media/): Commerce audience targeting and campaign execution capabilities.
- [Measurement](https://pubmatic.com/commerce-media/): Closed-loop measurement and performance analysis for commerce media campaigns.
- [Onsite Monetization](https://pubmatic.com/commerce-media/): Sponsored placements and monetization across retailer-owned digital properties.
- [Offsite Activation](https://pubmatic.com/commerce-media/): Extension of commerce audiences to open internet and omnichannel media buying.

## Identity and Addressability
- [Addressability Overview](https://pubmatic.com/addressability/): Privacy-aware identity and audience solutions for the evolving advertising ecosystem.
- [Identity Hub](https://pubmatic.com/addressability/): Interoperability with identity frameworks and addressable advertising workflows.
- [Audience Solutions](https://pubmatic.com/addressability/): Audience activation capabilities across publisher, buyer, and commerce media use cases.
- [Privacy-Centric Targeting](https://pubmatic.com/addressability/): Targeting approaches designed for signal loss and privacy regulation changes.
